label: D1 after a rare-unrewarded a2 trial (a2 -> S1, no reward), early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1, only when the reward input is 0, and almost only when the previous trial was a2 that rare-transitioned to S1 (prev_common==0 holds 75% of mass; prev_action==2 99%). The other ~18% of mass sits at the window-first D1 (rel -3), where the previous trial is outside the window, so the miss is mostly a window artifact. This is the model-based stay-on-a2 case (rare unrewarded means S2 is still good). Activity fades steadily with episode time and is gone by trial ~80, so ep_trial < 60 doubles precision (0.38 to 0.62). Silent at GO and D2, after rewarded trials, and nearly silent after a1 trials. Precision is limited: many qualifying D1s stay inactive, and deeper reward history did not separate them. Active steps fall in a narrow value band (7.13 to 7.54) with an a2-leaning policy. All variables are observed at D1; no future variables used.
